comment: The AmhiSangeet songbank. moods: triumph|steady|grind|turnaround_hope|distress|illusion|shock. energy 0-1 matches verdict intensity. Curate freely — this file IS the product.

songs.title: Chak De! India
songs.why_it_fits: The underdog delivered. Full team blowout quarter.

songs.title: Zinda
songs.why_it_fits: Earned the hard way — operating leverage finally kicking in.

songs.title: Lakshya (Title Track)
songs.why_it_fits: Guidance set, guidance hit. The mountain was climbed on plan.

songs.title: Dangal (Title Track)
songs.why_it_fits: Beat the incumbents on their own turf.

songs.title: Jai Ho
songs.why_it_fits: Destiny claimed after the long grind — a global-stage blowout.

songs.title: Malhari
songs.why_it_fits: Unapologetic victory dance. The con-call after a 30% beat.

songs.title: Apna Time Aayega
songs.why_it_fits: The time finally came — and the numbers prove it.

songs.title: Sultan (Title Track)
songs.why_it_fits: The heavyweight returns to form and takes the belt back.

songs.title: Dhoom Machale
songs.why_it_fits: Sheer momentum — every segment firing at once.

songs.title: Eye of the Tiger
songs.why_it_fits: Market-share fight won this quarter.

songs.title: We Are the Champions
songs.why_it_fits: Victory lap quarter. Management earned the con-call swagger.

songs.title: Don't Stop Me Now
songs.why_it_fits: Momentum quarter — every line item accelerating.

songs.title: We Will Rock You
songs.why_it_fits: The stomp-stomp-clap of market share being taken.

songs.title: Uptown Funk
songs.why_it_fits: Too hot. The quarter struts out of the exchange filing.

songs.title: Thunderstruck
songs.why_it_fits: Operating leverage hits like a lightning bolt.

songs.title: Hall of Fame
songs.why_it_fits: A quarter for the record books, dedicated to the doubters.

songs.title: Celebration
songs.why_it_fits: There's a party going on right here — in the cash flow statement.

songs.title: Aashayein
songs.why_it_fits: Quiet confidence, compounding hope. The long game on track.

songs.title: Yeh Honsla
songs.why_it_fits: Resolve without noise — margins held, book grew.

songs.title: Ilahi
songs.why_it_fits: Pleasant journey, no surprises, compounding scenery.

songs.title: Yun Hi Chala Chal
songs.why_it_fits: Keep walking, traveller — the compounding road is the destination.

songs.title: Musafir Hoon Yaaron
songs.why_it_fits: No fixed address, only direction. A journey stock doing journey things.

songs.title: Zindagi Ek Safar Hai Suhana
songs.why_it_fits: Life's a pleasant journey — so is a 12% compounder.

songs.title: Dil Dhadakne Do
songs.why_it_fits: Let it breathe and grow. Nothing to fix here.

songs.title: Safarnama
songs.why_it_fits: The travelogue of a thesis on track.

songs.title: Here Comes the Sun
songs.why_it_fits: It's all right. The numbers say so, gently.

songs.title: Lovely Day
songs.why_it_fits: A no-drama beat-and-hold. Just a lovely quarter.

songs.title: Three Little Birds
songs.why_it_fits: Every little thing gonna be all right — and the cash flow agrees.

songs.title: What a Wonderful World
songs.why_it_fits: Green trees, red roses, clean working capital.

songs.title: Don't Worry Be Happy
songs.why_it_fits: Every line item is fine. Exhale.

songs.title: Stand by Me
songs.why_it_fits: Hold through the noise — the franchise stands.

songs.title: Easy
songs.why_it_fits: Easy like a Sunday-morning quarter. No drama anywhere.

songs.title: Kar Har Maidaan Fateh
songs.why_it_fits: Fighting through a tough cycle, refusing to fold.

songs.title: Ruk Jaana Nahin
songs.why_it_fits: Flat quarter, head down, keep walking.

songs.title: Chale Chalo
songs.why_it_fits: The match is long; this innings was survival, not glory.

songs.title: Ziddi Dil
songs.why_it_fits: Stubborn heart in a punishing cycle. Refuses the standing count.

songs.title: Sadda Haq
songs.why_it_fits: Demanding its due from a market that won't give it.

songs.title: Khoon Chala
songs.why_it_fits: Quiet resolve while the environment burns.

songs.title: The Boxer
songs.why_it_fits: Cut and bruised but still standing. Sector headwinds absorbed.

songs.title: Patience
songs.why_it_fits: Nothing happened this quarter. That was the plan. Sit tight.

songs.title: Sixteen Tons
songs.why_it_fits: Another quarter older and deeper in debt. Working hard, owing the company store.

songs.title: Working Class Hero
songs.why_it_fits: Unglamorous toil. No re-rating for showing up — showing up anyway.

songs.title: I Won't Back Down
songs.why_it_fits: Standing ground at the gates of a hostile cycle.

songs.title: Under Pressure
songs.why_it_fits: Margins under pressure, management under pressure, everybody under pressure.

songs.title: Seven Nation Army
songs.why_it_fits: Marching bassline against an army of competitors.

songs.title: Lose Yourself
songs.why_it_fits: One shot at the turnaround capex. Do not miss.

songs.title: Phir Se Ud Chala
songs.why_it_fits: Off the ground again after the crash. Trough confirmed, wings unproven.

songs.title: Aaj Phir Jeene Ki Tamanna Hai
songs.why_it_fits: The will to live returns to the P&L.

songs.title: Roobaroo
songs.why_it_fits: Light visible, face to face with the inflection at last.

songs.title: Badal Pe Paon Hai
songs.why_it_fits: Feet on the clouds after years in the dirt — heady, unproven.

songs.title: Azaadiyan
songs.why_it_fits: Freedom from the legacy mess, first flight on new wings.

songs.title: Patakha Guddi
songs.why_it_fits: Untethered kite climbing — the wind finally favourable.

songs.title: Manja
songs.why_it_fits: Rebuilding the string, eyeing the sky again.

songs.title: Fix You
songs.why_it_fits: Lights will guide you home — the restructuring is working.

songs.title: I Can See Clearly Now
songs.why_it_fits: Rain gone, obstacles in plain sight. J-curve exiting the trough.

songs.title: Dog Days Are Over
songs.why_it_fits: The bad cycle ended — run from it no more.

songs.title: Don't Stop Believin'
songs.why_it_fits: Hold the thesis — the midnight train is moving.

songs.title: Beautiful Day
songs.why_it_fits: After the rain, a sky you could re-rate.

songs.title: Wake Me Up
songs.why_it_fits: Finding its way out of the wilderness years.

songs.title: Rise Up
songs.why_it_fits: Rising slowly, in spite of the ache in the balance sheet.

songs.title: Waqt Ne Kiya Kya Haseen Sitam
songs.why_it_fits: Time did this beautifully and cruelly. Structural decline in elegy form.

songs.title: Tujhse Naraz Nahi Zindagi
songs.why_it_fits: Not angry, just bewildered — like shareholders reading the segment results.

songs.title: Tanhayee
songs.why_it_fits: The loneliness of a stock the institutions have left.

songs.title: Luka Chuppi
songs.why_it_fits: A requiem for the earnings estimates that never came home.

songs.title: Agar Tum Saath Ho
songs.why_it_fits: Pleading with a stock that keeps hurting you.

songs.title: Jaane Woh Kaise Log The
songs.why_it_fits: Who were these people who got growth? We got impairments.

songs.title: Mera Jeevan Kora Kagaz
songs.why_it_fits: The book, blank where the earnings should have been.

songs.title: Hurt
songs.why_it_fits: The empire of dirt on the balance sheet, surveyed honestly.

songs.title: Everybody Hurts
songs.why_it_fits: Hold on — sector-wide pain, no one spared.

songs.title: The Sound of Silence
songs.why_it_fits: Management took no questions on the call.

songs.title: Yesterday
songs.why_it_fits: All the moats seemed so permanent yesterday.

songs.title: House of the Rising Sun
songs.why_it_fits: Ruin built on borrowed money. Tell the children not to do what I have done.

songs.title: Nothing Compares 2 U
songs.why_it_fits: Nothing compares to the margins of three years ago.

songs.title: Losing My Religion
songs.why_it_fits: The institutions are losing faith, holder by holder.

songs.title: Comfortably Numb
songs.why_it_fits: The pain faded into numbness around the third profit warning.

songs.title: Jhooth Bole Kauwa Kaate
songs.why_it_fits: Lie and the crow bites. The headline beat that the cash flow contradicts.

songs.title: Paisa Yeh Paisa
songs.why_it_fits: Money everywhere in the gross numbers, nowhere in the net.

songs.title: Dil To Bachcha Hai Ji
songs.why_it_fits: The heart is a child — it believes the investor presentation.

songs.title: Sapne Mein Milti Hai
songs.why_it_fits: The profitability exists — but only in the projections.

songs.title: Yeh Duniya Agar Mil Bhi Jaaye
songs.why_it_fits: Win the whole optical world — so what? The cash never came.

songs.title: Money for Nothing
songs.why_it_fits: Revenue for nothing and the take-rate ain't free.

songs.title: The Great Pretender
songs.why_it_fits: Adjusted-EBITDA in three-part harmony.

songs.title: Smooth Criminal
songs.why_it_fits: The one-offs hit so smoothly you almost didn't notice. Annie, are the auditors OK?

songs.title: Sweet Dreams (Are Made of This)
songs.why_it_fits: Everybody's looking for something — mostly the missing OCF.

songs.title: Fake Plastic Trees
songs.why_it_fits: It looks like real growth. It wears like real growth. It isn't.

songs.title: Smooth Operator
songs.why_it_fits: The promoter's diagonal from gross GMV to adjusted contribution profit.

songs.title: Hotel California
songs.why_it_fits: You can book the revenue any time you like, but the cash never leaves.

songs.title: The Grand Illusion
songs.why_it_fits: The title says it. Deep inside we're all the same take-rate.

songs.title: Yeh Kya Hua
songs.why_it_fits: What happened, how, when, why — the guidance-cut con call in one mukhda.

songs.title: Kasme Vaade Pyaar Wafa
songs.why_it_fits: Promises and guidance — all things that console; what of them came true?

songs.title: Chingari Koi Bhadke
songs.why_it_fits: When the protector starts the fire — promoter pledges, anyone?

songs.title: Aaj Mausam Bada Beimaan Hai
songs.why_it_fits: The weather turned treacherous mid-quarter.

songs.title: Kya Se Kya Ho Gaya
songs.why_it_fits: What it was, what it became — between two con-calls.

songs.title: Zindagi Kaisi Hai Paheli
songs.why_it_fits: Life's riddle: guidance raised in October, withdrawn in January.

songs.title: Mad World
songs.why_it_fits: Staring at the results screen, expressionless.

songs.title: Boulevard of Broken Dreams
songs.why_it_fits: Walking alone after the 18% gap-down.

songs.title: Zombie
songs.why_it_fits: The write-off that keeps clawing back, in your head.

songs.title: It's the End of the World as We Know It
songs.why_it_fits: Guidance pulled — and the promoter feels fine.

songs.title: Free Fallin'
songs.why_it_fits: The chart after the exchange filing.

songs.title: Landslide
songs.why_it_fits: Watched the estimates come down — well, the landslide brought them down.

songs.title: Bohemian Rhapsody
songs.why_it_fits: Is this the real life? Is this just adjusted EBITDA?
